Package org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.evaluate.expression.tree

Class ExpressionTextNavigation

java.lang.Object
org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.core.evaluate.expression.tree.ExpressionTextNavigation
public final class ExpressionTextNavigation extends Object
Words and brackets in the text of expressions, for moving through it and selecting parts of it. Words end where names, numbers, symbols and spaces meet, so item.size() has the words item, ., size, ( and ), where vanilla text fields only stop at spaces. Each bracket is a word of its own.

    • getKeyTarget

      @Nullable public static ExpressionTextNavigation.KeyTarget getKeyTarget(String text, int cursor, int lineBegin, int lineEnd, int key, boolean osx, boolean control, boolean alt)
      Where a key moves the cursor to, or deletes up to, for the keys where expressions differ from vanilla's text fields. Home and End move to the start or end of the line, not of the row it wraps on, as the text has no break there. Ctrl, or Option on macOS, moves and deletes by word. On macOS, Cmd moves and deletes to the start or end of the line, and Cmd with Up or Down to the start or end of the text, as in its own text fields.
      Parameters:
      text - A text.
      cursor - The position of the cursor.
      lineBegin - The begin of the line of the cursor, after the previous line break.
      lineEnd - The end of the line of the cursor, before the next line break.
      key - The key.
      osx - If this runs on macOS.
      control - If Ctrl is held, or Cmd on macOS, as vanilla's Screen.hasControlDown tells.
      alt - If Alt is held, which is Option on macOS.
      Returns:
      Where to, or null if the key works as in vanilla's text fields.
